sql: SELECT CASE WHEN s.posting_key IS NOT NULL THEN 'Mention RAG' ELSE 'No RAG' END AS rag_mention, median(f.comp_mid_usd) AS median_pay FROM fct_posting f LEFT JOIN (SELECT posting_key FROM posting_skills WHERE skill = 'rag') s ON f.posting_key = s.posting_key WHERE f.is_open AND f.remote_us AND f.is_canonical_listing GROUP BY 1
